verdict.rationale: cubic's own documented issue-analysis feature pulls linked Linear or Jira issues into PR review, checking whether changes meet the requirements. That is a real but narrow form of workflow-tool context. Nothing in the evidence shows connecting Slack, Google Drive or other workflow tools as context sources. missing for 10: Slack integration, Google Drive integration, a general mechanism for connecting arbitrary workflow tools as agent context, independent corroboration of the Jira/Linear integration

support.subject: As a developer, I can connect the agent to workflow tools like Jira, Slack, and Google Drive to extend its context

citations.quote: cubic can automatically analyze your pull requests to see if they meet the requirements from your linked Linear or Jira issues.
